[1/1] Make the Reforge packet a commit-ordered, hunk-by-hunk review

impact_assessment.why: The packet collapsed each changed file into one net diff, so a minute bug introduced and partly corrected across commits could hide; the operator asked for a hunk-by-hunk pass over every commit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every new commit's own hunks appear in order, with commit identity, while findings still validate against the current file and the lines new commits added.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: packet layout changes from net-per-file to per-commit hunks; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only history; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Render each new commit oldest-first with git show per path, keep binary/bookkeeping filters, update unit and integration tests, and append an ADR.
